name: RT Stock Manager for WooCommerce
author: raintech357

sections.description: This plugin provides a simple interface to manage product stock in WooCommerce. You can quickly update product quantities from a single page.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/rt-stock-manager-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the ‘Stock Manager’ menu in your WordPress admin to start managing stock.
sections.faq:
How do I use the stock manager?

After activating the plugin, a new menu item called “Stock Manager” will appear in your WordPress admin menu. Click on it to access the stock management page.

short_description: A simple stock manager for WooCommerce to update product quantities in bulk.
